deliverables.name: shopify_integration_guide

instructions: To embed a returns reason capture form on your custom platform, navigate to the 'Returns Flow' section of your admin interface. Click on the 'Customize Returns Flow' button and select the 'Reason Capture' tab. Choose the desired layout and fields for the form. Next, copy the provided JavaScript code and paste it into the 'Custom JavaScript' field. Finally, click 'Save' to apply the changes. The returns reason capture form will now be embedded in your returns flow.
